scope: Six requested horizons evaluated against identified retained evidence only; not a census of all possible datasets or an operational gate. No fresh provider requests, model, returns or trades.

inventory_reproduction.basis: Hash-bound working-tree inputs; existing inventory separately binds its 35 inputs. Private source bytes are not re-decoded in this package.

retained_price_evidence.basis: Raw unadjusted daily aggregates; dates match scheduled sessions only; latest observation was before Nov17 regular close.

shared_prerequisites.detail: Ten header-feature rows contain no decision, first-public time or outcome. Currently retained historical bytes and SEC acceptance times do not authenticate past availability.
shared_prerequisites.next_action: Select from existing predeclared cohorts or predeclare one, and specify a deterministic decision rule; use already retained primary evidence only where availability can be justified. If it cannot, retain as retrospective research and do not invent a decision clock.

shared_prerequisites.detail: OpenFIGI query and Nasdaq Listed snapshot are current observations, not historical security identity or continuous listing proof. Issuer CIK is not a unique share class.
shared_prerequisites.next_action: Require exact security/class and effective-date evidence for each proposed label interval; do not use ticker-only or current-mapping fallback.

shared_prerequisites.detail: AV account/intended-use training rights and broader redistribution are not established; free access and vendor training examples are not account entitlement.
shared_prerequisites.next_action: Review applicable existing account terms without exposing credentials; absent verified intended-use permission, retain metadata audits only. No new account, plan or extra quota request.

shared_prerequisites.detail: Raw daily prices have no validated split/dividend adjustment history. The 81 split-ratio rows in retained notes are issuer disclosure contexts, not effective-date events or watchlist-wide action coverage.
shared_prerequisites.next_action: Find an authorized official action source with effective dates and class identity before constructing a raw-price exclusion or adjustment policy; no inferred dates, guessed ratios or zero-action default.

shared_prerequisites.detail: No qualified labels or predictive metrics. Related-event groups, temporal splits, overlapping-window purging, survivorship and delisting review, benchmark identity and costs remain necessary.
shared_prerequisites.next_action: Reuse existing structural split/receipt audits once genuine examples exist; do not train a baseline merely to produce metrics.
